_doc: Item sets (Item Database rule 22, Formulas J; world-depth Stage 5, 2026-11-26). A set: id, name ("English (Hán-Việt)"), pieces (2-5 named template ids, as combat_library.json items), bonuses and story. A bonus with `modifiers` (catalogue keys with scopes) applies while set_bonus_min_pieces distinct pieces are worn (Formulas J1, about half one item's budget); a bonus with `effect` (its name) applies at the full set, run through its engine record `record` (an Effect dict, id set:<id>:full) or listed as unmodelled until it is written. Read by tools/design/combat_sim/fight.py, BuildFileCompiler and StatSheet. Empty until the Stage 6 sect exports fill it (the depth sets sit in design/world/depth/sects/*.items.json until then).

sets.name: Black and White Stones (Hắc Bạch Tử)
sets.story: Made and won by her own hands, never issued by the Pavilion. A go player's pair: the white side shown, the black side kept.

sets.name: Clear Glaze (Lưu Ly Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The sword and ring are the Keeper's gifts at her disciple's Kết Đan; the robe is Khương's own. She wears the set as an heir would, and asks every year why it is not the Regalia.

sets.name: Fisher's Heirs (Ngư Gia Song Kiện)
sets.story: One piece from his master and one from his grandmother, the Pavilion and the fallen sect. Liễu wears both and has told neither giver about the other.

sets.name: Glacier Vigil (Băng Bích Thủ Tịch)

bonuses.effect: The Peak Does Not Move (Phong Bất Động)

sets.story: Two pieces from Tần Ngưng Sương, the banner from the Array's laying and the seal from her deathbed, and one Cố cut from her own cave wall. Cố has worn all three since 1010 and has not come down. Whoever she gives the seal to will learn the last order.

sets.name: Ice-Fisher's Three (Băng Ngư Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Second Wind on the Ice (Băng Thượng Hồi Khí)

sets.story: Made by the coast for its own man: the blade forged at Trấn Sa from a fisher's ice-cutter, the coat from Đoàn's family, the gourd refilled by the villages. Thẩm wears all three in the Hall of Cold Law so the inner halls see what the coast pays.

sets.name: Keeper of the Lid (Thủ Cái Song Bảo)
sets.story: Both cut from one locust tree of Hòe Âm, the wood sent by her childhood friend Thái Lê Tuyết when Tiết laid the Array's last nodes. She wears them with the Clear-Heart Mirror, which is the Keeper's, not hers.

sets.name: Red and White Plums (Hồng Bạch Song Mai)
sets.story: Lãnh Hương Các's two plum swords and the cape of its last swordsman, Phó Thanh Mai. The red was lost at Cô Thành in 726. Phó Ám Hương wears the white and his father's cape, and the set is whole only if he takes the red back from Phượng Minh.

sets.name: Ice Heart Regalia (Băng Tâm Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Keeper's Stillness (Chưởng Hồ Chi Tĩnh)

sets.story: Tần held all three. The Mirror went to Tiết Hàn Mai in 820 for the Array's last nodes, and Sở Ngọc Hồ has never asked for it back. The Regalia is whole only in one pair of hands, so succession and Tiết's death decide who holds it.

sets.name: Step for Step (Bộ Bộ Tương Tùy)
sets.story: The robe she was found in and her master's first sword: the two things the Keeper has given anyone along with her surname.
